context:
Small, mechanical: one new property, call-site substitutions, plus explicit
unknown-platform semantics. Do NOT consolidate the capability registries here
(gated on ADR-3); this item only makes the existing lookups use the right key.
description:
From the 2026-07-12 tuning review, finding R1 (evidence pinned to commit acfb8992).

benchbox/platforms/base/adapter.py:714 calls
`validate_for_platform(self.platform_name)` with the human display string
("ClickHouse (Local)", "StarRocks"). TuningType.is_compatible_with_platform
(benchbox/core/tuning/interface.py:79-164) lowercases it and looks it up in a
map keyed by canonical types ("clickhouse"), so multi-word display names match
nothing and every enabled tuning type errors -> ValueError after data
generation. Verified empirically: a default-constructed config (constraints
default enabled=True) yields 4 errors on StarRocks / "ClickHouse (Local)" /
Doris / Trino; even the key "clickhouse" fails on default-enabled
foreign_keys/check_constraints. TuningMetadataManager also persists the display
name into the metadata table (benchbox/core/tuning/metadata.py:207).

Fix: introduce a canonical platform-type accessor on adapters (the CLI key,
e.g. database_config.type) and route every tuning-capability lookup and
metadata persistence through it. Also decide-in-code the unknown-platform
behavior explicitly (warn + treat as no-capability, never a crash keyed on
string formatting).

anti_patterns.dont: add starrocks/doris/etc to the hardcoded compat map as a fix
anti_patterns.why: that grows the drift problem this plan later removes

anti_patterns.dont: normalize display names with string surgery (strip parens); use the config type key

preserves.behavior: Existing passing validation behavior for duckdb/databricks tuned templates
validate_for_platform's public signature (callers exist in cli/config.py and platforms/base/tuning_config.py)

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "from benchbox.core.tuning.interface import UnifiedTuningConfiguration; c=UnifiedTuningConfiguration(); print(c.validate_for_platform('StarRocks'))"
verifications.expected: No spurious 'not supported by platform' errors caused purely by display-name formatting

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/core/tuning tests/unit/cli/test_tuning* -q

Line refs at HEAD: adapter.py:714 call site (validate_for_platform(self.platform_name)); interface.py:69-164 is_compatible_with_platform 9-key map; metadata.py:207 persists display name. After fix: probe returns [] for 'StarRocks', 'ClickHouse (Local)', 'Doris' - PASS.
work_units.summary: Re-validate pinned evidence at current HEAD (validate_for_platform probe, line refs)

work_units.notes: Added PlatformAdapter.canonical_platform_type: prefers platform_config['type'] (the CLI/DatabaseConfig canonical key), falls back to normalized platform_name (lowercase, spaces->hyphens; documented as best-effort). Switched the adapter execute-path validation call site, TuningConfigMixin.validate_* methods, and TuningMetadataManager (create-table/index dialect dispatch + persisted platform column via new _platform_key helper with getattr fallback for duck-typed stubs). ConfigManager._validate_unified_tuning_config default already uses the canonical 'database.preferred' key; docstring now pins that contract. Review follow-up (scope extension beyond only_modify, justified): the live CLI path strips 'type' from DatabaseConfig before construction (core/platform_config.py), so get_platform_adapter (platforms/__init__.py) now injects the resolved canonical registry key into the constructor config and restores it post-construction on platform_config for from_config implementations that rebuild their config with selected keys (e.g. DuckDB).
work_units.summary: Add canonical_platform_type to PlatformAdapter and switch tuning lookups to it

work_units.notes: Added UnifiedTuningConfiguration.validate_for_platform_detailed(platform) -> (errors, warnings); validate_for_platform keeps its list-of-strings signature and now returns errors only. Constraint types (primary/foreign/unique/check) downgrade to warnings on ANY platform (they default enabled=True); table-layout and platform-specific types stay hard errors only for platforms present in the compat map (TuningType.is_known_platform), else warnings. Adapter logs warnings and raises only on errors; CLI ConfigManager prints warnings and fails only on errors. No platforms added to the compat map (per anti_patterns).
work_units.summary: Make unknown-platform capability lookups an explicit warning path, not an empty-set hard fail

work_units.notes: Added tests/unit/core/tuning/test_platform_identity_keys.py: display-name configs produce no errors (warnings only), known-platform layout incompatibilities still error (duckdb distribution/z_ordering, databricks liquid+partitioning), canonical_platform_type config-type/fallback behavior, and TuningMetadataManager.save_tunings persisting the canonical key via stub adapter. Updated 2 mock-based tests to the detailed validation API and 1 delegation test to the canonical key. Suites green: tests/unit/core/tuning + tests/unit/cli/test_tuning* + affected files (559 passed); wider platforms/base + dataframe tuning (1510 passed). Review follow-up tests: parenthesized display-name fallback pinned ('ClickHouse (Local)' -> 'clickhouse-(local)', not a canonical key), factory-built duckdb/sqlite3-alias adapters report canonical keys on the live path, and the compat-map key set is pinned in sync with _KNOWN_COMPATIBILITY_PLATFORMS (now derived from the module-level _PLATFORM_COMPATIBILITY_MAP - single source of truth, behavior identical). Post-review suites: tests/unit/core/tuning + tests/unit/cli/test_tuning* + tests/unit/platforms/base (1069 passed).
work_units.summary: Regression tests: tuned-mode validation on starrocks/clickhouse/doris display names no longer crashes on name formatting; canonical key persisted in metadata table
